title: Golden UAV 30
description: Golden screening workspace: 30 records from uav-crop-weed-v03 under its frozen v0.3 protocol. The quality gate for the production plan.
research_questions: How do UAV crop-weed mapping studies define and evaluate reliability under spectral degradation, sensor differences, and temporal shift?
Which datasets, sensors, dates, fields, and split units support the reported generalization claims?
How are uncertainty, calibration, missing evidence, and failed transfer reported?
Which evidence gaps remain after separating dataset diversity, model mechanisms, and demonstrated external validation?
